title: Several Accelerated and Stable Pseudo-Energy-Dissipative Lagrange Multiplier Methods based on Second-order Flow and Variable Splitting
summary: Based on second-order inertial dynamics, we develop two accelerated Lagrange multiplier (LM)-based optimization methods: Linear LM-based second-order flow method and linear LM-based variable and operator splitting method for unconstrained non-convex optimization problems. Relaxed and adaptive variants of both methods are proposed to prevent degeneration of the Lagrange multiplier and to enable automatic adjustment of the time step size.
